Food icon sources

Google Noto Emoji v2.047
Copyright Google LLC.
Icon family observed at: https://icon-icons.com/pack/noto-emoji-food-drink-icons/1447
Egg detail reference: https://icon-icons.com/icon/egg-food/98878
Official SVG source: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji/tree/v2.047/svg
Official project licensing notes: https://github.com/googlefonts/noto-emoji/blob/v2.047/README.md
Most image resources: Apache License 2.0 (included as food-noto-Apache-2.0.txt).
The repository also includes SIL Open Font License 1.1 (included as food-noto-OFL.txt).
The egg, milk, apple, banana, rice, bread, broccoli, sweet-potato, potato and orange SVGs are unmodified official image resources.
The oats, chicken, tofu, salmon, yogurt and oil SVGs are original illustrations for this website, drawn to complement the food icon style. They are not downloaded icons.

Nutrition data
USDA National Nutrient Database for Standard Reference, Release 28, revised May 2016.
Downloaded from: https://fdc.nal.usda.gov/fdc-datasets/SR-Legacy-Archive/sr28abbr.zip
Energy values were checked in the official ABBREV.txt per 100g edible portion.
Dataset descriptions are recorded in foods.js as sourceFood, sourceNdb and sourceDataset.
Common serving sizes are adjustable interface examples, not fixed actual weights.

2026-10-30 expansion: the 15 new food SVGs are original illustrations for this site. Nutrition sources and qualifications are recorded in food-directory-expansion-sources.txt and per-food metadata in foods.js.
